scope: Official public documentation only. No credentials read and no account or inference requests performed by this audit.
defaultModelPolicy: Examples are documentation examples, not confirmed account entitlements or recommended default model selections.

providers.label: NVIDIA
providers.ambiguity: Hosted NVIDIA inference credentials and self-hosted NIM credentials are different configurations; select an available model from account discovery.

providers.label: PERPLEXITY
providers.ambiguity: Current official docs recommend Agent API. /v1/responses is an alias of /v1/agent. Sonar support ended September 27, 2026; do not infer current Chat Completions behavior from older integrations. Provider tools/defaults differ from OpenAI; use an explicit no-tools smoke request.

providers.label: YOU
providers.ambiguity: Endpoint is the You.com Inference Router. A label alone does not establish that a key has inference access rather than another You.com product. Discover accessible models first. Streaming includes a final usage event with empty choices before [DONE].

providers.label: PORTKEY
providers.ambiguity: Portkey is a gateway. The account-specific provider slug/configuration cannot be inferred from PORTKEY_API_KEY. Do not send the key directly to an upstream model provider or guess a route. Official OpenAI SDK examples also accept the gateway key as api_key; native direct HTTP should use the documented x-portkey-api-key header.

providers.label: SAKANA
providers.ambiguity: Official console supports Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages. Fugu subscription access and other model billing are product-specific; verify account discovery before selecting a model.

providers.label: THEROUTER
providers.ambiguity: Global endpoint is documented; legacy regional endpoint is retired. Model IDs are gateway-specific and model availability/account budget still require discovery or account configuration.
